_comment: PLACEHOLDER, not art: a stepped block that proves the box primitive and the two-material path end to end. The output id is this file's stem (placeholder_block -> assets/base/gltf/greebles/placeholder_block.glb). Coordinates are in CELLS, in the plate's own frame: +Y is out of the plate and y=0 is the mounting face, so every part sits at half its own height. Phase B replaces these with authored kit pieces.
